sentences.text: Hugo croit que sa sœur a gagné à la loterie et qu'elle ne lui a rien dit.
sentences.en: Hugo thinks his sister won the lottery and didn't tell him.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 복권에 당첨됐는데 자기한테 말하지 않았다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Léa a gagné son cours de cuisine grâce à une loterie au supermarché.
sentences.en: Léa won her cooking class through a supermarket lottery.
sentences.ko: 레아는 슈퍼마켓 경품 추첨으로 요리 수업을 따냈어요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Hugo prend un antibiotique, d'où sa mauvaise humeur au téléphone.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister is on an antibiotic, which explains her bad mood on the phone.
sentences.ko: 위고의 누나는 항생제를 먹고 있어서 전화로 기분이 안 좋았던 거예요.

sentences.text: Le chef explique à Léa que le vinaigre agit presque comme un antibiotique naturel.
sentences.en: The chef explains to Léa that vinegar acts almost like a natural antibiotic.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 레아에게 식초가 거의 천연 항생제처럼 작용한다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Hugo se souvient du dortoir de la colonie où il partageait tout avec sa sœur.
sentences.en: Hugo remembers the summer camp dormitory where he shared everything with his sister.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나와 뭐든 나눠 쓰던 캠프 기숙사를 떠올려요.

sentences.text: Léa apprend à cuisiner pour les jeunes du dortoir où elle est surveillante.
sentences.en: Léa is learning to cook for the young people in the dormitory where she's a supervisor.
sentences.ko: 레아는 사감으로 일하는 기숙사 학생들을 위해 요리를 배워요.

sentences.text: Hugo reproche à sa sœur de vouloir éduquer ses enfants à sa place.
sentences.en: Hugo accuses his sister of wanting to raise his children for him.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 자기 대신 자기 아이들을 가르치려 한다고 나무라요.

sentences.text: Le chef de Léa veut éduquer le palais de ses élèves aux épices.
sentences.en: Léa's chef wants to train his students' palates to spices.
sentences.ko: 레아의 셰프는 학생들의 입맛을 향신료에 길들이고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Le rire de la sœur de Hugo est si contagieux qu'il oublie vite sa colère.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister's laugh is so contagious that he quickly forgets his anger.
sentences.ko: 누나의 웃음이 워낙 전염성이 있어서 위고는 금방 화를 잊어요.

sentences.text: Léa a un rhume contagieux, alors elle porte un masque pendant le cours.
sentences.en: Léa has a contagious cold, so she wears a mask during class.
sentences.ko: 레아는 옮기 쉬운 감기에 걸려서 수업 내내 마스크를 써요.

sentences.text: Hugo et sa sœur ont hérité de l'entêtement de toute une lignée de paysans.
sentences.en: Hugo and his sister inherited the stubbornness of a whole line of farmers.
sentences.ko: 위고와 누나는 농부 집안 대대로 내려온 고집을 물려받았어요.

sentences.text: Le chef de Léa vient d'une longue lignée de pâtissiers.
sentences.en: Léa's chef comes from a long line of pastry chefs.
sentences.ko: 레아의 셰프는 대대로 제과사 집안 출신이에요.

sentences.text: Hugo avait pris la générosité de sa sœur pour de la pitié.
sentences.en: Hugo had mistaken his sister's generosity for pity.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나의 너그러움을 동정으로 오해했어요.

sentences.text: Léa remercie le chef pour sa générosité : il partage tous ses secrets.
sentences.en: Léa thanks the chef for his generosity: he shares all his secrets.
sentences.ko: 레아는 비법을 다 알려 주는 셰프의 너그러움에 고마워해요.

sentences.text: Hugo pense que sa sœur a voulu le ridiculiser devant leurs cousins.
sentences.en: Hugo thinks his sister wanted to make fun of him in front of their cousins.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 사촌들 앞에서 자기를 놀림거리로 만들려 했다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Le chef de Léa ne cherche jamais à ridiculiser un élève qui rate sa sauce.
sentences.en: Léa's chef never tries to make fun of a student who ruins their sauce.
sentences.ko: 레아의 셰프는 소스를 망친 학생을 절대 놀리지 않아요.

sentences.text: Pour éviter sa sœur, Hugo fait un long détour par le parc.
sentences.en: To avoid his sister, Hugo takes a long detour through the park.
sentences.ko: 누나를 피하려고 위고는 공원으로 멀리 돌아가요.

sentences.text: En rentrant du cours, Léa fait un détour par le marché pour acheter des herbes.
sentences.en: On her way home from class, Léa makes a detour through the market to buy herbs.
sentences.ko: 수업이 끝나고 레아는 허브를 사러 시장에 들렀다 가요.

sentences.text: Le dimanche sans nouvelles de sa sœur est déprimant pour Hugo.
sentences.en: The Sunday without news from his sister is depressing for Hugo.
sentences.ko: 누나에게서 연락이 없는 일요일이 위고에게는 우울해요.

sentences.text: Un soufflé qui retombe, c'est déprimant, avoue Léa en riant.
sentences.en: A soufflé that collapses is depressing, Léa admits with a laugh.
sentences.ko: 꺼져 버린 수플레는 우울하다고 레아가 웃으며 털어놓아요.

sentences.text: La dispute a commencé quand Hugo a oublié sa corvée de vaisselle chez leurs parents.
sentences.en: The argument started when Hugo forgot his dishwashing chore at their parents' house.
sentences.ko: 위고가 부모님 댁에서 설거지 당번을 잊으면서 다툼이 시작됐어요.

sentences.text: Pour Léa, éplucher les oignons reste une vraie corvée.
sentences.en: For Léa, peeling onions is still a real chore.
sentences.ko: 레아에게 양파 껍질 벗기기는 여전히 진짜 귀찮은 일이에요.

sentences.text: Les reproches de sa sœur finissent par fatiguer Hugo.
sentences.en: His sister's reproaches end up wearing Hugo out.
sentences.ko: 누나의 잔소리에 위고는 결국 지쳐요.

sentences.text: Pétrir la pâte à pain finit par fatiguer les bras de Léa.
sentences.en: Kneading the bread dough ends up tiring Léa's arms.
sentences.ko: 빵 반죽을 치대다 보면 레아의 팔이 지쳐요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Hugo l'appelle son petit vagabond, car il change de ville chaque année.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister calls him her little wanderer, because he moves to a new town every year.
sentences.ko: 위고가 해마다 도시를 옮겨 다녀서 누나는 그를 꼬마 방랑자라고 불러요.

sentences.text: Léa apporte les restes du cours à un vagabond assis près de l'école.
sentences.en: Léa brings the leftovers from class to a homeless man sitting near the school.
sentences.ko: 레아는 수업에서 남은 음식을 학교 근처에 앉아 있는 떠돌이에게 가져다줘요.

sentences.text: Hugo voit dans une vitrine le cadeau que sa sœur voulait depuis longtemps.
sentences.en: Hugo sees in a shop window the gift his sister had wanted for a long time.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 오래전부터 갖고 싶어 하던 선물을 진열장에서 봐요.

sentences.text: Les gâteaux du cours sont exposés dans la vitrine de l'école, et Léa en est fière.
sentences.en: The class's cakes are displayed in the school's window, and Léa is proud of it.
sentences.ko: 수업에서 만든 케이크가 학교 진열장에 놓여서 레아는 뿌듯해요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Hugo lui reproche de trop consommer de vêtements neufs.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister criticizes him for buying too many new clothes.
sentences.ko: 위고의 누나는 그가 새 옷을 너무 많이 산다고 나무라요.

sentences.text: Le chef apprend à Léa à consommer moins de beurre sans perdre le goût.
sentences.en: The chef teaches Léa to use less butter without losing flavor.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 레아에게 맛을 잃지 않으면서 버터를 덜 쓰는 법을 가르쳐요.

sentences.text: Le désaccord entre Hugo et sa sœur porte sur la vente de la maison familiale.
sentences.en: The disagreement between Hugo and his sister is about selling the family house.
sentences.ko: 위고와 누나의 의견 차이는 가족의 집을 파는 문제에 있어요.

sentences.text: Léa et sa voisine de table ont un petit désaccord sur la cuisson des pâtes.
sentences.en: Léa and the woman next to her have a small disagreement about cooking pasta.
sentences.ko: 레아와 옆자리 사람은 파스타 삶는 법을 두고 조금 의견이 달라요.

sentences.text: Hugo ne voulait pas contrarier sa sœur en refusant son invitation.
sentences.en: Hugo didn't want to upset his sister by turning down her invitation.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나의 초대를 거절해서 누나를 속상하게 하고 싶지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Léa n'ose pas contrarier le chef en ajoutant du sucre dans la sauce.
sentences.en: Léa doesn't dare annoy the chef by adding sugar to the sauce.
sentences.ko: 레아는 소스에 설탕을 넣어 셰프 기분을 상하게 할 엄두가 안 나요.

sentences.text: Leur mère pousse Hugo à renouer le dialogue avec sa sœur.
sentences.en: Their mother urges Hugo to start talking with his sister again.
sentences.ko: 어머니는 위고에게 누나와 다시 대화를 나누라고 권해요.

sentences.text: Le cours commence toujours par un dialogue entre le chef et les élèves sur leurs goûts.
sentences.en: The class always begins with a conversation between the chef and the students about their tastes.
sentences.ko: 수업은 늘 셰프와 학생들이 입맛에 대해 이야기를 나누는 것으로 시작해요.

sentences.text: Hugo a reçu un message enragé de sa sœur à minuit.
sentences.en: Hugo got a furious message from his sister at midnight.
sentences.ko: 위고는 자정에 누나에게서 화가 잔뜩 난 메시지를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Léa rit en voyant le chef faire semblant d'être enragé devant une soupe trop salée.
sentences.en: Léa laughs as the chef pretends to be furious at an over-salted soup.
sentences.ko: 셰프가 너무 짠 수프 앞에서 화난 척하는 걸 보고 레아가 웃어요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Hugo a gardé la vieille cuisinière en fonte de leur grand-mère.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister kept their grandmother's old cast-iron stove.
sentences.ko: 위고의 누나는 할머니의 오래된 무쇠 화덕을 간직했어요.

sentences.text: Léa doit apprendre à régler la cuisinière à gaz de l'atelier.
sentences.en: Léa has to learn how to adjust the workshop's gas stove.
sentences.ko: 레아는 실습실 가스레인지 다루는 법을 배워야 해요.

sentences.text: Hugo et sa sœur vivaient en parfaite harmonie avant cette histoire d'héritage.
sentences.en: Hugo and his sister lived in perfect harmony before this inheritance business.
sentences.ko: 위고와 누나는 이 유산 문제 전에는 완벽하게 사이좋게 지냈어요.

sentences.text: Le chef montre à Léa comment trouver l'harmonie entre le sucré et l'acide.
sentences.en: The chef shows Léa how to find the balance between sweet and sour.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 레아에게 단맛과 신맛의 조화를 찾는 법을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Dans l'excitation de la fête, Hugo a lancé une remarque maladroite à sa sœur.
sentences.en: In the excitement of the party, Hugo said something clumsy to his sister.
sentences.ko: 위고는 파티의 들뜬 분위기 속에서 누나에게 서툰 말을 했어요.

sentences.text: Léa sent l'excitation monter quand le chef goûte son plat.
sentences.en: Léa feels the excitement rising when the chef tastes her dish.
sentences.ko: 셰프가 자기 요리를 맛볼 때 레아는 가슴이 두근거려요.

sentences.text: Dans un élan de tendresse, Hugo prend sa sœur dans ses bras.
sentences.en: In a burst of tenderness, Hugo hugs his sister.
sentences.ko: 위고는 다정한 마음이 북받쳐 누나를 안아요.

sentences.text: Après ce cours, Léa a pris l'élan nécessaire pour ouvrir son propre café.
sentences.en: After this class, Léa found the drive she needed to open her own café.
sentences.ko: 이 수업 뒤에 레아는 자기 카페를 열 힘을 얻었어요.

sentences.text: Trouver un cadeau d'excuse pour sa sœur est une vraie galère pour Hugo.
sentences.en: Finding an apology gift for his sister is a real hassle for Hugo.
sentences.ko: 누나에게 줄 사과 선물을 찾는 게 위고에게는 정말 고역이에요.

sentences.text: Réussir la mayonnaise à la main a été une galère pour Léa.
sentences.en: Getting mayonnaise right by hand was a struggle for Léa.
sentences.ko: 손으로 마요네즈를 만드는 건 레아에게 고생이었어요.

sentences.text: Une tasse de chocolat chaud suffit à apaiser Hugo après la dispute.
sentences.en: A cup of hot chocolate is enough to calm Hugo after the argument.
sentences.ko: 다툼 후 위고는 핫초코 한 잔으로 마음을 가라앉혀요.

sentences.text: Le parfum du pain chaud suffit à apaiser Léa après une longue journée.
sentences.en: The smell of warm bread is enough to soothe Léa after a long day.
sentences.ko: 긴 하루 끝에 따뜻한 빵 냄새만으로도 레아는 마음이 편안해져요.

sentences.text: Hugo a trouvé humiliant que sa sœur raconte son échec à tout le monde.
sentences.en: Hugo found it humiliating that his sister told everyone about his failure.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 자기 실패를 모두에게 말한 게 창피했어요.

sentences.text: Léa a trouvé humiliant de brûler la tarte devant tout le groupe.
sentences.en: Léa found it humiliating to burn the tart in front of the whole group.
sentences.ko: 레아는 모두 앞에서 타르트를 태운 게 창피했어요.

sentences.text: Les silences de sa sœur commencent à lasser Hugo.
sentences.en: His sister's silences are starting to wear on Hugo.
sentences.ko: 누나의 침묵에 위고는 지쳐 가요.

sentences.text: Léa ne risque pas de se lasser des recettes de pâtes.
sentences.en: Léa is not likely to tire of pasta recipes.
sentences.ko: 레아는 파스타 요리법에 질릴 일이 없어요.

sentences.text: Hugo a cru voir du mépris dans le regard de sa sœur, mais elle était juste fatiguée.
sentences.en: Hugo thought he saw contempt in his sister's eyes, but she was just tired.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나 눈빛에서 경멸을 봤다고 생각했지만 누나는 그냥 피곤했던 거예요.

sentences.text: Le chef de Léa n'a aucun mépris pour la cuisine simple de tous les jours.
sentences.en: Léa's chef has no contempt for simple everyday cooking.
sentences.ko: 레아의 셰프는 소박한 집밥을 전혀 깔보지 않아요.

sentences.text: Hugo, très embarrassé, ne sait pas comment s'excuser auprès de sa sœur.
sentences.en: Hugo, very embarrassed, doesn't know how to apologize to his sister.
sentences.ko: 위고는 민망해서 누나에게 어떻게 사과해야 할지 몰라요.

sentences.text: Léa est un peu embarrassée quand le chef lit sa recette à voix haute.
sentences.en: Léa is a little embarrassed when the chef reads her recipe aloud.
sentences.ko: 셰프가 레아의 요리법을 소리 내어 읽자 레아는 조금 쑥스러워요.

sentences.text: Quand leur chat est mort, c'est Hugo qui a su consoler sa sœur.
sentences.en: When their cat died, it was Hugo who knew how to comfort his sister.
sentences.ko: 고양이가 죽었을 때 누나를 달래 준 건 위고였어요.

sentences.text: Léa essaie de consoler sa voisine dont la crème a tourné.
sentences.en: Léa tries to comfort the woman next to her whose cream has curdled.
sentences.ko: 레아는 크림이 상해 버린 옆자리 사람을 달래 줘요.

sentences.text: Hugo se rappelle la caresse de sa sœur sur ses cheveux quand il était malade.
sentences.en: Hugo remembers his sister stroking his hair when he was ill.
sentences.ko: 위고는 아팠을 때 누나가 머리를 쓰다듬어 주던 걸 기억해요.

sentences.text: Le chef donne une petite caresse au chien de l'école qui attend sous la table.
sentences.en: The chef gives a little stroke to the school dog waiting under the table.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 탁자 밑에서 기다리는 학교 강아지를 살짝 쓰다듬어요.

sentences.text: Avant d'appeler sa sœur, Hugo est si anxieux qu'il fait les cent pas.
sentences.en: Before calling his sister, Hugo is so anxious that he paces up and down.
sentences.ko: 누나에게 전화하기 전에 위고는 너무 불안해서 왔다 갔다 해요.

sentences.text: Léa est anxieuse avant l'examen final de pâtisserie.
sentences.en: Léa is anxious before the final pastry exam.
sentences.ko: 레아는 제과 기말 시험을 앞두고 불안해요.

sentences.text: Le beau-frère de Hugo a toujours eu de la sympathie pour lui.
sentences.en: Hugo's brother-in-law has always had a soft spot for him.
sentences.ko: 위고의 매형은 늘 위고에게 호감을 가져 왔어요.

sentences.text: Léa a tout de suite eu de la sympathie pour la vieille dame à côté d'elle.
sentences.en: Léa immediately took a liking to the old lady next to her.
sentences.ko: 레아는 옆자리 할머니에게 바로 호감이 갔어요.

sentences.text: Hugo pense que leurs parents ont une préférence pour sa sœur.
sentences.en: Hugo thinks their parents favor his sister.
sentences.ko: 위고는 부모님이 누나를 더 좋아한다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Léa a une préférence pour les desserts aux fruits rouges.
sentences.en: Léa has a preference for red-fruit desserts.
sentences.ko: 레아는 베리류 디저트를 더 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Hugo a découvert que sa sœur avait le béguin pour son meilleur ami.
sentences.en: Hugo found out that his sister had a crush on his best friend.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나가 자기 단짝 친구에게 반했다는 걸 알았어요.

sentences.text: Les autres élèves devinent vite que Léa a le béguin pour le jeune assistant.
sentences.en: The other students quickly guess that Léa has a crush on the young assistant.
sentences.ko: 다른 학생들은 레아가 젊은 조교에게 반했다는 걸 금방 눈치채요.

sentences.text: Hugo a entendu un rire hystérique dans la cuisine et a cru que sa sœur se moquait de lui.
sentences.en: Hugo heard hysterical laughter in the kitchen and thought his sister was mocking him.
sentences.ko: 위고는 부엌에서 들린 자지러지는 웃음소리를 듣고 누나가 자기를 비웃는 줄 알았어요.

sentences.text: Quand la poêle prend feu, une élève devient hystérique, mais Léa garde son calme.
sentences.en: When the pan catches fire, a student becomes hysterical, but Léa stays calm.
sentences.ko: 프라이팬에 불이 붙자 한 학생은 패닉에 빠지지만 레아는 침착해요.

sentences.text: La sœur de Hugo n'avait aucune intention de lui faire une offense.
sentences.en: Hugo's sister had no intention of offending him.
sentences.ko: 위고의 누나는 그를 모욕할 생각이 전혀 없었어요.

sentences.text: Pour le chef, mettre du ketchup sur ses pâtes est une offense, et Léa le taquine.
sentences.en: To the chef, putting ketchup on his pasta is an insult, and Léa teases him about it.
sentences.ko: 셰프에게 파스타에 케첩을 뿌리는 건 모욕이라서 레아가 그걸로 놀려요.

sentences.text: Par orgueil, Hugo refuse d'appeler sa sœur le premier.
sentences.en: Out of pride, Hugo refuses to call his sister first.
sentences.ko: 위고는 자존심 때문에 먼저 누나에게 전화하지 않아요.

sentences.text: Le chef parle de son orgueil de cuisinier, mais Léa le trouve très humble.
sentences.en: The chef talks about his pride as a cook, but Léa finds him very humble.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 요리사의 자존심을 이야기하지만 레아는 그가 아주 겸손하다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Hugo n'a pas pris en considération les soucis de sa sœur au travail.
sentences.en: Hugo didn't take his sister's worries at work into account.
sentences.ko: 위고는 누나의 직장 고민을 고려하지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Le chef traite chaque élève avec beaucoup de considération, et Léa l'apprécie.
sentences.en: The chef treats every student with great respect, and Léa appreciates it.
sentences.ko: 셰프는 학생 한 명 한 명을 존중으로 대해서 레아는 그 점이 좋아요.

sentences.text: Quand sa sœur lui ouvre enfin la porte, Hugo est très ému.
sentences.en: When his sister finally opens the door to him, Hugo is very moved.
sentences.ko: 누나가 마침내 문을 열어 주자 위고는 크게 감동해요.

sentences.text: Léa est émue quand sa mère goûte le gâteau qu'elle a appris à faire.
sentences.en: Léa is moved when her mother tastes the cake she learned to make.
sentences.ko: 어머니가 자기가 배운 케이크를 맛볼 때 레아는 뭉클해요.
